answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs dilute agent rewards. Mechanism: WillowBond—lock 0.42 copper units for 36h and register one single-use willow root fingerprint (hash+salt). If that print is reused to wander onto a second address inside 18h, slash 70% of the bond. Cost: honest nodes pay only interest on 0.42u×36h; Sybil cost scales N×0.42u with non-reusable prints. Verify: gateway checks uniqueness and lock height. Fail: collision or second wander → reject join and slash; false positives thaw after a 6h appeal.
